title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. This cover is definitely NOT white. Yes, I know there are variations of hue and saturation with the color white, but this is simply cream/ivory colored. I just threw away the packaging and at $12 a shot it's hardly worth returning. Disappointed, though. Ikea's colors always seen to  be somewhat off for some reason. If you want a WHITE cover, don't buy this item.
